Workflows.title: Start a simulator session, verify the dashboard is usable, and cover one safe read-only account activity journey. Do not create an account, submit personal information, transfer funds, pay bills, or perform external financial activity.
Workflows.goal: The bank simulator dashboard renders with a welcome modal; The dashboard displays account activity summary cards; The Account Activity page displays the checking account transactions table; The transaction table updates to display saving account activity
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Open the simulator landing page and click GET STARTED NOW — The bank simulator dashboard renders with a welcome modal
2. Dismiss the welcome modal dialog — The dashboard displays account activity summary cards
3. Click VIEW ACCOUNT on Checking Account Activity — The Account Activity page displays the checking account transactions table
4. Switch account view to Saving account — The transaction table updates to display saving account activity
Workflows.test_name: verify bank simulator dashboard and view checking account activity
Workflows.pom_test_name: verify bank simulator dashboard and view checking account activity
preconditions: User is on the NGPF bank simulator landing page

test_steps.action: Open the simulator landing page and click GET STARTED NOW
test_steps.expected: The bank simulator dashboard renders with a welcome modal
The dashboard displays account activity summary cards

test_steps.action: Click VIEW ACCOUNT on Checking Account Activity
test_steps.expected: The Account Activity page displays the checking account transactions table
